decisions.advance: All numeric thresholds pass, at least 8 participants complete the known-item task set, at least 2 return unaided, and no unresolved critical privacy or source-loss issue exists.
decisions.narrow: Retrieval and source integrity remain safe but activation, latency, capture friction, or a non-critical cohort slice misses its threshold; publish the failure and narrow scope before adding formats or capture.
decisions.stop: Any critical privacy/source-integrity defect, fabricated or unanchored result, unrecoverable data loss, or failure of the rights-clean benchmark makes the next expansion ineligible.
